name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
summary: A button that shows or hides a region under it.
description: A button that shows or hides a region under it: details, advanced settings, a log. A disclosure: a trigger (a real button with any content) and a region that reveals under it, pushing the rows below. One caret convention: a right caret that turns down, mirrored right-to-left. Three trigger shapes cover the system's disclosures: a whole row (task rows), an inline header on the text line ("Thought for 12s") and a section header (sidebar "Chats"). Behaviour and ARIA come from the Zag collapsible machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte. This is the only place the reveal recipe lives.

anatomy.description: data-state=open|closed from the engine. Hosts add their own class and restyle the parts by data-slot. The trigger and region are its direct children, or descendants in no nested collapsible (a trigger in a footer under the region); a host whose trigger is another component's button uses the engine's Trigger anywhere inside the Root (recommendation-card).
Direct child of the root. aria-expanded, aria-controls, data-state=open|closed, data-disabled from the engine.
Right caret (ph caret-right) that turns down 90deg while open; first or last child of the trigger; carries kbd-instant
The trigger's content. Any markup may go inside. In a row it wraps (the caret, the meta and its first line share a 24px first line); in inline and section it truncates, with a title while cut.
The region. Direct child of the root; carries kbd-instant. Closed: data-state=closed and hidden (out of the layout and the tab order). Settled open: no data-state.
The one child of the region; it clips while the region moves. Put the host's content here.
Plain detail text, inset to line up with the trigger's label

open.description: Open or closed. React: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange; Vue: v-model:open; Svelte: bind:open.

disabled.description: The trigger does nothing and dims.

variant.description: row: the whole row is the trigger (44px, caret in a 28px box). inline: a text-sized header on the text line that bleeds 6px. section: a 28px quiet header (12px/500, ink-2, ink on hover).

caret.description: Where the caret sits in the trigger. Sections put it first.

label.description: The trigger's content: text, or markup (React node, Vue slot `label`, Svelte snippet).

meta.description: Trailing muted note in the trigger.

detail.description: Plain detail text shown in the region, inset like the trigger.

keepLayout.description: A closed region stays laid out at zero height (invisible, out of the tab order) instead of display: none, so entrances inside it do not replay when it reopens (thinking-state, tool-chips).

triggerClass.description: A class added to the trigger (a host's hook).

labelClass.description: A class added to the label part (a host's hook).

slots.default: The region's content, after the detail text.
slots.label: Vue: the trigger's content when it is more than text (React: label as a node; Svelte: label as a snippet).

keyboard: Tab reaches the trigger; nothing inside a closed region is reachable
Enter / Space on the trigger toggle the region; the change is instant (no reveal, no caret turn)
A disabled trigger stays in the tab order and ignores Enter, Space and clicks
notes: The trigger is a real button; its whole content is the accessible name, so keep the label short or give it aria-label.
The region leaves the layout (hidden) once the exit has played, which also takes it out of the accessibility tree.

motion: reveal: grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr over duration.reveal easing.out-strong, opacity over duration.base ease; rows below move with it
exit: the same transition back; the engine waits for the fndn-collapsible-exit hold (duration.reveal) before it hides the region
keyboard: region and caret are instant (kbd-instant)
notes: Composition: the trigger and the region are direct children of the root, so collapsibles nest. A host puts its own class on the root (className / class) and styles its parts through `.<host> > [data-slot=collapsible-trigger]`.
Set it from outside by controlling `open` (React open / onOpenChange, Vue v-model:open, Svelte bind:open).
